title: epan: Support 64 bit time_t in rel_time_to_str
description:
rel_time_to_str converts a nstime_t describing a relative time
into a string using days/hours/mins/secs. Since time_t can be
(and usually is) 64 bits, as currently written it can overflow.
Most relative times shouldn't be that large, but it's simple to
handle it rather than overflow. (We could use Julian years for
very large numbers, perhaps a decision for another time.)

Fixes Coverity CID 1509367.

There are also a host of other functions for converting 32 bit
integers representing relative time in the API. We probably don't
need to do anything about those, as people can use a nstime_t
instead.
